bigpicture.description: Big Picture mode toggles fullscreen and can minimise the window. Showing and focusing the window is done natively from Rust (tray, single-instance).

default.description: Minimal permissions for the Mochi window: listen for native events, pick files and read the startup deep link. Mochi's own commands are not gated by capabilities.

mochipack.description: Choose where to save an exported modpack (.mochipack).

sounds.description: Choose where to save an exported interface sound pack.

updater.description: Check for, download and install Mochi updates, then relaunch.
